about.label: About
about.title: End-to-end engineering.
about.body: I have led teams, designed architectures and shipped products at companies like Facily and Locaweb. Today I am part of the founding team of a healthtech. I work with any stack: TypeScript, Vue, React, Node.js, Python, PHP/Laravel, Ruby and cloud. I have spoken at PHP Summit and TheDevConference.
